verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is an API-first service that runs without a UI. It offers batch and realtime APIs, language SDKs, and API keys. Management tokens let teams create projects and manage keys programmatically, and Kubernetes or self-hosted deployment supports automated orchestration, so unattended automation is clearly supported at its core. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific documentation and examples, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
